report.incidentSummary: Starting at 09:22 IST (03:52 UTC) on 2026-10-20, mf-order-service experienced approximately 6% order failures specifically impacting SIP order submissions. The failures generated HTTP 500 errors caused by an unhandled NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee whenever processing orders for folios lacking nominee records. This regression was introduced by deployment CHG-48219 (v4.0.7 -> v4.1.0, 'release: nominee validation for SIP orders'), which completed at 09:20 IST (03:50 UTC). The on-call SRE initially misdiagnosed the timeline by assuming the deployment timestamp of 09:20 was UTC (14:50 IST), prematurely dismissing the release.
report.rootCauseStatement: Deployment CHG-48219 of mf-order-service (version 4.1.0), deployed at 09:20 IST (03:50 UTC) via legacy-jenkins-mum, introduced an unhandled NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee when processing SIP orders for folios without an existing nominee record, causing ~6% of SIP orders to fail with HTTP 500.

hypotheses.cause: Deployment CHG-48219 of mf-order-service v4.1.0 ('release: nominee validation for SIP orders') introduced an unhandled NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee when processing SIP orders for folios without a nominee record.
hypotheses.rationale: Logs directly confirm that all 1,293 errors in mf-order-service starting at 03:52:07 UTC (09:22 IST) were HTTP 500 NullPointerExceptions inside FolioValidator.validateNominee on version 4.1.0. This aligns precisely with CHG-48219 completed at 09:20 IST (03:50 UTC).

hypotheses.cause: Upstream RTA, payment gateway, or folio master data degradation caused fund orders or validation to fail on SIP creation.
hypotheses.rationale: Metrics and logs for payment-service, mandate-service, and bank-connector showed steady baseline error rates (~0.4-1.0%) with 0 errors during the onset window, ruling out payment or mandate upstream dependencies. Error logs also show failures are internal NullPointerExceptions rather than upstream network rejections.

facts.statement: mf-order-service emitted 1,293 ERROR logs starting at 2026-10-20T03:52:07.747Z with message 'SIP order failed: NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee (folio F-<id> has no nominee record)' and HTTP status 500 under version 4.1.0.

Deployment CHG-48219 on mf-order-service updated the application from version 4.0.7 to 4.1.0 with summary 'release: nominee validation for SIP orders' via legacy-jenkins-mum at timestamp 2026-10-20T09:20:00.000 with tz: 'none'.

payment-service, mandate-service, and bank-connector exhibited normal baseline error rates (~0.40%, ~1.02%, and ~0.49% respectively) and bank-connector timeout counts remained low (mean 0.44/min) throughout 03:00 to 10:15 UTC.
There were zero ERROR or FATAL log events in bank-connector, mandate-service, and payment-service between 03:45 and 04:15 UTC.
debit-worker did not experience widespread failures, logging only 1 isolated error for insufficient funds at 06:39:35 UTC.

inferences.statement: The deployer 'legacy-jenkins-mum' logged its completion timestamp 2026-10-20T09:20:00 in Indian Standard Time (UTC+05:30), which corresponds to 03:50:00 UTC, exactly 2 minutes prior to the error onset at 03:52:07 UTC. The SRE erroneously read 09:20 as UTC (14:50 IST).
The newly added nominee validation logic does not safely handle null nominee records when querying folios without a registered nominee, leading directly to the ~6% SIP failure rate.

assumptions.statement: Approximately 6% of mutual fund folios on the platform do not have an associated nominee record registered.

timeline.event: Deployment CHG-48219 (v4.0.7 -> v4.1.0) completes on mf-order-service introducing nominee validation for SIP orders.
First NullPointerException error logged by mf-order-service v4.1.0 in FolioValidator.validateNominee for folio F-38261329.
Over 1,290 SIP orders fail with HTTP 500 NullPointerException on folios lacking nominee records.
On-call SRE raises SEV2 incident INC-9077, suspecting upstream RTA and ruling out mf-order-service release due to timezone misinterpretation.

confidence.rationale: The log evidence provides explicit stack trace messages showing NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee running version 4.1.0 starting exactly 2 minutes after deployment CHG-48219 completed, while payment and banking services operated normally.

gaps.description: Specific code diff for FolioValidator.validateNominee in build-60433 was not directly inspected via repository tools.
gaps.impact: Minimal, as the exception message and class/method are explicitly stated in the application error logs.

recommendedActions.action: Roll back mf-order-service from version 4.1.0 to version 4.0.7 immediately.
recommendedActions.rationale: Version 4.0.7 did not enforce nominee validation via the buggy FolioValidator code, which will instantly restore SIP order success for affected folios.
recommendedActions.verification: Verify HTTP 500 error logs with 'NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee' cease immediately in mf-order-service logs.

recommendedActions.action: Fix FolioValidator.validateNominee to safely handle missing/null nominee records with appropriate validation error handling or defaults instead of throwing an unhandled NullPointerException.
recommendedActions.rationale: Prevents unhandled runtime crashes and provides proper feedback or fallback for folios without nominees.
recommendedActions.verification: Add unit and integration tests covering folios with null nominee fields and verify successful pipeline execution.

recommendedActions.action: Standardize legacy-jenkins-mum to write deployment timestamps in ISO-8601 UTC format with explicit timezone offsets.
recommendedActions.rationale: The deployment timestamp lacking timezone offset caused on-call engineers to mistake 09:20 IST for 09:20 UTC (14:50 IST), leading to misdiagnosis.
recommendedActions.verification: Inspect change log timestamps from legacy-jenkins-mum to ensure timestamps end in 'Z' or valid '+05:30' offset.

report.justification: The investigation conclusively establishes the root cause despite no critic review: deployment CHG-48219 introduced version 4.1.0 whose code throws an explicit NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee, exactly matching the error onset at 03:52:07 UTC.

payload.markdown:
# Investigation report: Fund order errors since morning

**Outcome:** conclusive · **Stop reason:** completed · **Confidence:** 0.95 · **Written by:** reporting agent

## Summary
Starting at 09:22 IST (03:52 UTC) on 2026-10-20, mf-order-service experienced approximately 6% order failures specifically impacting SIP order submissions. The failures generated HTTP 500 errors caused by an unhandled NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee whenever processing orders for folios lacking nominee records. This regression was introduced by deployment CHG-48219 (v4.0.7 -> v4.1.0, 'release: nominee validation for SIP orders'), which completed at 09:20 IST (03:50 UTC). The on-call SRE initially misdiagnosed the timeline by assuming the deployment timestamp of 09:20 was UTC (14:50 IST), prematurely dismissing the release.

**Root cause:** Deployment CHG-48219 of mf-order-service (version 4.1.0), deployed at 09:20 IST (03:50 UTC) via legacy-jenkins-mum, introduced an unhandled NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee when processing SIP orders for folios without an existing nominee record, causing ~6% of SIP orders to fail with HTTP 500.

## Hypotheses
1. **Deployment CHG-48219 of mf-order-service v4.1.0 ('release: nominee validation for SIP orders') introduced an unhandled NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee when processing SIP orders for folios without a nominee record.** — `mf-order-service`, deployment_regression, confidence 0.95, supported
   - Supporting: [ev_1, ev_5, ev_8, ev_9, ev_12, ev_13] · Contradicting: none
   - Logs directly confirm that all 1,293 errors in mf-order-service starting at 03:52:07 UTC (09:22 IST) were HTTP 500 NullPointerExceptions inside FolioValidator.validateNominee on version 4.1.0. This aligns precisely with CHG-48219 completed at 09:20 IST (03:50 UTC).
2. **Upstream RTA, payment gateway, or folio master data degradation caused fund orders or validation to fail on SIP creation.** — `mf-order-service`, upstream_dependency_degradation, confidence 0.05, ruled_out
   - Supporting: none · Contradicting: [ev_2, ev_3, ev_4, ev_10, ev_11, ev_12, ev_16]
   - Metrics and logs for payment-service, mandate-service, and bank-connector showed steady baseline error rates (~0.4-1.0%) with 0 errors during the onset window, ruling out payment or mandate upstream dependencies. Error logs also show failures are internal NullPointerExceptions rather than upstream network rejections.

## Facts
- mf-order-service emitted 1,293 ERROR logs starting at 2026-10-20T03:52:07.747Z with message 'SIP order failed: NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee (folio F-<id> has no nominee record)' and HTTP status 500 under version 4.1.0. [ev_1, ev_8, ev_12, ev_13]
- Deployment CHG-48219 on mf-order-service updated the application from version 4.0.7 to 4.1.0 with summary 'release: nominee validation for SIP orders' via legacy-jenkins-mum at timestamp 2026-10-20T09:20:00.000 with tz: 'none'. [ev_5, ev_9]
- payment-service, mandate-service, and bank-connector exhibited normal baseline error rates (~0.40%, ~1.02%, and ~0.49% respectively) and bank-connector timeout counts remained low (mean 0.44/min) throughout 03:00 to 10:15 UTC. [ev_2, ev_3, ev_4, ev_10]
- There were zero ERROR or FATAL log events in bank-connector, mandate-service, and payment-service between 03:45 and 04:15 UTC. [ev_11]
- debit-worker did not experience widespread failures, logging only 1 isolated error for insufficient funds at 06:39:35 UTC. [ev_1, ev_8]

## Inferences
- The deployer 'legacy-jenkins-mum' logged its completion timestamp 2026-10-20T09:20:00 in Indian Standard Time (UTC+05:30), which corresponds to 03:50:00 UTC, exactly 2 minutes prior to the error onset at 03:52:07 UTC. The SRE erroneously read 09:20 as UTC (14:50 IST). [ev_5, ev_9, ev_12]
- The newly added nominee validation logic does not safely handle null nominee records when querying folios without a registered nominee, leading directly to the ~6% SIP failure rate. [ev_1, ev_5, ev_12]

## Assumptions
- Approximately 6% of mutual fund folios on the platform do not have an associated nominee record registered.

## Timeline
- **2026-10-20 09:20:00 IST (03:50:00 UTC)** Deployment CHG-48219 (v4.0.7 -> v4.1.0) completes on mf-order-service introducing nominee validation for SIP orders. [ev_5, ev_9]
- **2026-10-20 09:22:07 IST (03:52:07 UTC)** First NullPointerException error logged by mf-order-service v4.1.0 in FolioValidator.validateNominee for folio F-38261329. [ev_1, ev_12, ev_13]
- **2026-10-20 09:22 - 15:45 IST (03:52 - 10:15 UTC)** Over 1,290 SIP orders fail with HTTP 500 NullPointerException on folios lacking nominee records. [ev_1, ev_8]
- **2026-10-20 15:40:00 IST (10:10:00 UTC)** On-call SRE raises SEV2 incident INC-9077, suspecting upstream RTA and ruling out mf-order-service release due to timezone misinterpretation. [ev_5]

## Confidence
0.95: The log evidence provides explicit stack trace messages showing NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee running version 4.1.0 starting exactly 2 minutes after deployment CHG-48219 completed, while payment and banking services operated normally.

## Gaps
- Specific code diff for FolioValidator.validateNominee in build-60433 was not directly inspected via repository tools. (impact: Minimal, as the exception message and class/method are explicitly stated in the application error logs.)

## Recommended actions (not executed)
- **[now]** Roll back mf-order-service from version 4.1.0 to version 4.0.7 immediately. [ev_1, ev_5, ev_12]
  - Why: Version 4.0.7 did not enforce nominee validation via the buggy FolioValidator code, which will instantly restore SIP order success for affected folios.
  - Verify: Verify HTTP 500 error logs with 'NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee' cease immediately in mf-order-service logs.
- **[next]** Fix FolioValidator.validateNominee to safely handle missing/null nominee records with appropriate validation error handling or defaults instead of throwing an unhandled NullPointerException. [ev_1, ev_12]
  - Why: Prevents unhandled runtime crashes and provides proper feedback or fallback for folios without nominees.
  - Verify: Add unit and integration tests covering folios with null nominee fields and verify successful pipeline execution.
- **[later]** Standardize legacy-jenkins-mum to write deployment timestamps in ISO-8601 UTC format with explicit timezone offsets. [ev_5, ev_9]
  - Why: The deployment timestamp lacking timezone offset caused on-call engineers to mistake 09:20 IST for 09:20 UTC (14:50 IST), leading to misdiagnosis.
  - Verify: Inspect change log timestamps from legacy-jenkins-mum to ensure timestamps end in 'Z' or valid '+05:30' offset.

## Justification
The investigation conclusively establishes the root cause despite no critic review: deployment CHG-48219 introduced version 4.1.0 whose code throws an explicit NullPointerException in FolioValidator.validateNominee, exactly matching the error onset at 03:52:07 UTC.

Cited evidence: ev_1, ev_2, ev_3, ev_4, ev_5, ev_8, ev_9, ev_10, ev_11, ev_12, ev_13, ev_16
Investigation window: 2026-10-20 08:30 IST to 2026-10-20 15:45 IST
